label: v0.1
workload: Three dated status records per synthetic entity; hybrid search with valid-time and knowledge-time filters; offline lexical embeddings.

metrics.first_open_ms: Opening the imported corpus for the first time: every record is validated and indexed.
metrics.open_unchanged_ms: Median of 5 opens of a store whose files have not changed.
metrics.full_rebuild_ms: Median of 3 forced rebuilds that validate every record.
metrics.write_ms_median: Adding one fact to an open store.
metrics.warm_search_ms_median: One hybrid search through a store and retriever reused for every search; the first search fills their caches.
metrics.cold_search_ms_median: Open the store, create a new retriever, run one hybrid search and close the store, like one CLI call, excluding interpreter start-up.

notes: Single local run per size; medians over repeated operations.
Writes are measured after imported files leave the recently-modified window.
Every search result is checked for the expected entity, value and record ID.
Cold searches exclude interpreter start-up and imports; the operating system's file cache is warm.
Timings are machine-specific and not comparable across hardware.
